invariants: Missing values are never replaced with zero.
Missing values are never imputed or inferred.
Provider sentinels are explicit provider-and-field contract data and are never guessed globally.
NaN and positive or negative infinity are ineligible for verification metrics.
Raw provenance is preserved as a safe serializable token without emitting NaN or Infinity JSON literals.
Corpus integration is read-only and performs no repair.

integrations.verification_metrics: reject missing or non-finite numeric inputs before scoring
integrations.verification_missingness: attach granular normalization reason evidence without automatic weighting
integrations.provider_health: optional value_missingness evidence block, independent of freshness classification
integrations.corpus_integrity: read-only blocking audit with no repair
